theater: 遼東安市城與韓進洛一線

battle.name: 韓進洛
battle.theater: 遼東安市城與韓進洛一線
battle.brief: 貞觀七年（613）十二月，唐太宗再伐高句麗，李勣主力南下遼東，薛仁貴以白袍先鋒在安市與韓進洛一線擊破高句麗大軍，拔安市城，進抵漢江。卡面羅馬短劍不在此戰場上，可對照者為唐軍環首直刀、長槊與角弓，以及高句麗的鐵札甲與環首刀。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐太宗貞觀七年（613）十一月發動的第二次伐高句麗戰役中的一段接觸，交戰雙方都是隋唐以來東北亞國際秩序的兩端。唐軍方面由中書令李靖與司空李勣分任行軍總管與行軍大總管，調發諸道兵共三十萬，編制上仍以隋代府兵制的軍府與縣鄉兵為骨幹，並雜以契苾、奚等部族騎兵與沿途調集的州縣團練。東路大軍自北平、幽州方向南下攻遼東，李靖另率輕兵自登州、萊州浮海東渡，循鴨綠水登陸奇襲蓋牟城，形成海陸兩路夾擊之勢；在安市正面作戰的先鋒則歸李勣序列，由白袍參軍薛仁貴率領。高句麗一方是渤海國既有的軍國體系，以平壤為中樞，安市城主楊萬春所部據城自守，並由各地調集步騎，沿太子河上游與遼東通道佈防，企圖以城池、河流與崎嶇山地遲滯唐軍深入。這不是唐朝與一個現代國家之間的戰爭，而是唐帝國與渤海高句麗政權在朝鮮半島北部與遼東地帶的直接角力。
countriesEn: This engagement was one episode inside the second Tang campaign against Goguryeo, ordered by Emperor Taizong in the eleventh month of the Zhenguan seventh year (613), and the two belligerents stood at opposite ends of the Northeast Asian order reshaped by the Sui. On the Tang side, the chancellor Li Jing and the chancellor Li Ji held the posts of expeditionary commander and grand expeditionary commander. They mustered about three hundred thousand men from the circuits, but the backbone remained the militia registers inherited from the Sui fubing system, mixed in with cavalry from the Qibi, Xi and other steppe peoples and with provincial levies gathered along the route. The main column under Li Ji marched south from the Beiping and Youzhou direction to take Liaodong, while Li Jing with a picked light force sailed east from Dengzhou and Laizhou, crossed the Yalu River and struck Gaimou by night, creating a pincer from sea and land. The advance guard that fought in the open field along the Anshi and Hanjinluo line belonged to Li Ji's host and was led by the white-robed staff officer Xue Rengui. Goguryeo fought with the military-administrative structure it had inherited as the state of Balhae, centred on Pyongyang: Yang Wanchun, commandant of Anshi, held the city shut, while levies were drawn in from the provinces and deployed as foot and horse along the upper Taizi River and the corridors of Liaodong, hoping to stall the Tang advance with rivers, fortresses and broken mountain ground. This was not a war between a Tang empire and a modern nation, but the direct collision of the Tang state with the Bohai polity of Goguryeo over the northern peninsula and the Liaodong country.
people: 唐太宗李世民是這場戰役的最終決策者。他在隋煬帝三征高句麗失敗二十餘年之後，趁高句麗內部君權與權臣相爭、國力轉衰，渤海與新羅在半島南部衝突升溫之際，於貞觀七年下令東征，志在恢復隋朝未竟的半島經營，並切斷東北通往草原的通道。中書令李靖以數千銳卒乘海船東渡，於霧中夜渡鴨綠水，奇襲蓋牟城、焚其城郭，是全役最見機智的一著；司空李勣則以主力正面壓迫遼東、安市，穩紮穩打，逐步壓縮高句麗的防禦縱深。名字最為後世記住的，是薛仁貴——本名薛禮，傳世以字行行世，彼時不過是李勣麾下一名白袍參軍，曾在安市城下自請為先鋒，率敢死之士在韓進洛一線衝擊高句麗軍陣。市城守將楊萬春的堅守不降，亦直接牽動其後攻防。此外，契苾何力等歸附的契苾部、奚部將領亦率部眾隨軍參戰，遼東道行軍的幕僚、通譯與糧秣官員則在背後維持這場遠征能持續下去。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong of Tang, Li Shimin, was the man who made the final decision to fight. More than twenty years after the Sui Yangdi had failed three times against Goguryeo, the emperor judged that the kingdom was weakened by quarrels between its king and its great families, that Baekje's rival Balhae was locked in conflict in the south of the peninsula, and that the cost of striking now would be at its lowest; in the seventh year of Zhenguan he therefore ordered the eastern expedition, hoping to finish what the Sui had begun in the peninsula and to cut the northeastern corridor to the steppe. Li Jing carried the most conspicuous stroke of the whole campaign: with a few thousand picked men he crossed the sea in ships, passed the Yalu River by night in thick fog, surprised Gaimou and burned its walls. Li Ji, by contrast, pressed forward with the main host from Liaodong toward Anshi, methodically squeezing the depth of Goguryeo's defence. The name later memory kept is Xue Rengui, born Xue Li and known throughout history by his courtesy name, at that moment no more than a white-robed staff officer in Li Ji's host, who asked to lead the assault before the walls of Anshi and drove his suicide squad into the Goguryeo line along the Hanjinluo road. Yang Wanchun, the commandant who refused to surrender at Anshi, also shaped every decision that followed. Generals of the surrendered Qibi and Xi peoples, such as Qibi Heli, fought with their own contingents, while the staff, translators and commissary officers of the Liaodong route quietly kept the expedition supplied.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是羅馬短劍（Gladius），羅馬共和與帝國早期步兵用於近身刺擊的短刃，約公元前一百年前後已定型：鐵質雙刃，護手狹窄，劍身重心靠近劍柄，配大圓盾時可反覆快速刺出。它並不存在於唐與高句麗的戰場上，其價值在於示範「短兵相接如何進行」。可以對照的，是唐軍的近戰裝備：步兵以角弓、臂弩、環首直刀與長槊為主，鎧甲多屬山文甲、明光甲一類札葉甲，配兜鍪、臂韝與護膝，騎兵則著騎甲、馬披，乘披甲戰馬；高句麗守軍同樣以角弓、鐵札甲、環首刀與長矛作戰，據城時大量使用弓弩與帶鉤長杆兵器，騎兵以輕裝衝陣為主。唐軍攻城另備雲梯、巢車、撞車與繩索飛梯，海路運糧的糧船與沿途的輜重車隊，則是這場戰役真正吃緊的裝備。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Roman gladius, the short stabbing blade used by the infantry of the Roman Republic and early Empire, a form that was already settled by about the year one hundred BC: an iron double-edged blade with a narrow guard and its centre of gravity close to the hilt, capable of being thrust again and again when worked together with the large round shield. It never existed on the battlefield of Tang against Goguryeo, and its value here is to demonstrate how close combat is actually conducted. The comparable kit of the Tang army was built around the composite bow, the arm bow and crossbow, the ring-pommel straight sword and the long spear: the infantry of the Sui and Tang fought in lamellar armour of the Shanwen and Mingguang types, with a helmet, arm guards and knee defences, while the cavalry wore horse armour and caparisoned their mounts. Goguryeo's defenders used composite bows, iron lamellar armour, ring-pommel sabres and spears as well, and when fighting from the walls relied heavily on bows, crossbows and long hooked pole-arms, while their light horse was used to run down and harass. For the siege the Tang also brought scaling ladders, siege towers, battering rams and rope ladders, but the equipment that really mattered most was the grain fleet and the baggage trains that fed the army on the coastal route.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術骨架是「大迂迴加正面壓迫」：李靖以海路奇襲奪取蓋牟城，先行拔除高句麗在鴨綠江口與遼東的耳目與物資節點；李勣主力循遼東官道南下，逐城攻下蓋牟、遼東、安市一線的據點，把防禦縱深一層層推向平壤。安市城下與韓進洛一線的接觸，延續了唐軍「先以矢石覆壓、再以步卒突其鋒、最後長槊壓陣」的固定套路：遠程以弓弩、投石消耗城外部隊，近身由白袍先鋒利用地形缺口衝入，破陣之後步卒以槊列進逼，騎兵繞擊側背，不讓敵軍得以逸散重整。高句麗的應對則是充分利用安市城依山帶水、僅一面可攻的險固，閉門不戰，等待各地援軍到齊，同時以輕騎不斷襲擾唐軍的運糧線，企圖在唐軍飢疲時迫其退兵。糧道與糧船，才是唐軍在韓進洛至漢江之間真正的勝負手。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of the Tang army was a wide strategic envelopment combined with frontal pressure. Li Jing seized Gaimou by sea, removing the ears and the supply node that Goguryeo held at the mouth of the Yalu and in Liaodong, while Li Ji's main host marched down the Liaodong roads and took the strongholds of the Gaimou, Liaodong and Anshi line one after another, pushing the depth of the Goguryeo defence steadily back toward Pyongyang. The fighting around the walls of Anshi and along the Hanjinluo road followed the fixed Tang method of covering an enemy with arrows and stones first, then breaking his front with infantry, and finally pressing forward with the long spear: at range, bows, crossbows and stone-throwers wore down the troops deployed outside the walls; in close contact, the white-robed vanguard forced the gap in the terrain, and once the line was broken, spearmen advanced in order while the horse rode round the flanks, denying the enemy the chance to reform and withdraw. Goguryeo's answer was to use the natural defence of Anshi, a site girded by hills and water and assailable on one side only, to shut the gates and refuse to fight, waiting for reinforcements from the provinces while sending light horse to harry the Tang supply line, hoping the army would be starved and forced to withdraw. The grain route and the grain boats, not the swords, were the real hinge of the campaign between Hanjinluo and the Han River.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。唐軍出師兵額，《舊唐書》《新唐書》與《資治通鑑》均記作發兵三十萬，加上沿途諸道兵，實際集結的兵力當遠少於此數；李靖東渡的輕兵只以數千人計，奇襲蓋牟城，記斬首二千餘級；安市一役記斬首五萬餘級，數字明顯帶有史家誇飾，與高句麗大軍的記載同屬量級可疑的戰報；高句麗投入安市方向與漢江一線的兵力，通鑑多記為十五萬步騎。時間線是十月出師、十一月破蓋牟城、十二月進攻城下、翌年正月遇雪班師，在東北作戰不足三個月。氣候是決定性的變數：貞觀八年正月平地大雪，士卒僵仆者數千，軍糧不繼，唐軍終不得不退。里程方面，自登州浮海至鴨綠水登岸點約六七百里海程；由遼東至安市為一百餘里山路；安市至漢江平壤一線，又有二百餘里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The Tang host is recorded in the Old Book of Tang, the New Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror as three hundred thousand men drawn up for the campaign; with contingents added from the circuits along the way, the number actually mustered was certainly far smaller. Li Jing's striking force that crossed the sea numbered only a few thousand, and the night surprise at Gaimou is credited with cutting off some two thousand heads. The battle at Anshi is credited with more than fifty thousand heads taken, a figure that plainly carries the exaggeration of dynastic historiography and belongs, like the reported size of the Goguryeo army, to that class of numbers that cannot be taken at face value. The troops Goguryeo committed against the Anshi and Han River lines are usually recorded as a hundred and fifty thousand foot and horse. The time line runs: the army set out in the tenth month, Gaimou fell in the eleventh, the siege of the city came in the twelfth, and the withdrawal ordered in the first month of the following year, so that less than three months were spent in the field in the north-east. Climate was the decisive variable: in the first month of Zhenguan eight there was a heavy fall of snow on the plain, several thousand men froze or died in the cold, the rations gave out, and the army had no choice but to retire. As for distance, the sea passage from Dengzhou to the landing place on the Yalu is roughly six or seven hundred li, the road from Liaodong to Anshi a little over a hundred li of mountain track, and the further stretch from Anshi to the Han River and Pyongyang something over two hundred li.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因有三層。第一層是唐帝國的邊策：隋煬帝三征高句麗耗空國力，隋亡之後，高句麗趁亂恢復了對鴨綠江以北的經營，又屢次出兵新羅、截斷唐朝通往百濟的海上通道，唐廷無法容忍。第二層是高句麗自身的變化：王權與權臣的長期內鬥、二十年對隋的消耗戰，使渤海國力轉衰，太宗判斷此時出兵代價最低，一旦成功即可一勞永逸地解決東北問題。第三層是時機與個人的動機：貞觀七年太宗三十五歲，突厥已平，關中與河東的糧運漸趨穩定，帝國財政轉好，東征的物質條件具備。對唐軍而言，進攻的理由不只是雪隋朝之恥，更是建立半島秩序、截斷北方草原通道；對高句麗而言，這是一場守土之戰，因為任何唐軍的深入，都意味著平壤直接暴露在唐騎的刀鋒之下。
causeEn: The war had three layers of cause. The first was Tang frontier policy: the Sui Yangdi's three campaigns against Goguryeo had drained the empire, and after the Sui fell the kingdom recovered its position north of the Yalu, struck at Baekje again and again and cut the sea lanes from Tang to the south, which the court would not tolerate. The second was the change inside Goguryeo itself: the long quarrels between the king and his great families and two decades of attrition against the Sui had worn down the state of Balhae, and Taizong judged that the cost of striking would now be at its lowest and that a single success would settle the north-eastern question for good. The third was timing and personal ambition: in the seventh year of Zhenguan the emperor was thirty-five, the Turks were already settled, the grain traffic through Guanzhong and Hedong was growing steady and the finances of the empire were recovering, so the material conditions for a campaign existed. For the Tang the reason to attack was not merely to wipe out the shame of the Sui, but to establish an order on the peninsula and cut the northern steppe corridor; for Goguryeo it was a war to defend the ground itself, because any deep penetration by the Tang meant Pyongyang itself would be exposed to Tang sabres.
impact: 從短期看，韓進洛所在的這一段戰役並未改變東北亞的權力格局：唐軍攻下安市，卻始終未能拿下平壤，反而在漢江受阻、遇雪退兵，第二次征高句麗的目標落空。從長期看，代價雖大，倒換來三樣東西。一、唐廷自此確認高句麗的城堡防禦體系與冬季氣候足以抵銷唐軍在裝備與兵員上的優勢，此後轉向長期消耗與外交並行，貞觀十八年遣蕭瑀、唐儉、柳謇等使高句麗議和，並以冊封與互市換取邊境安寧，使東北線維持了相對長期的穩定。二、薛仁貴等一批將領在此役中嶄露頭角，其事蹟成為後世史家與說部反覆書寫的素材，貢獻了唐代尚武精神的一整套敘事。三、安市之役的攻城實踐，累積了雲梯、巢車、投石、穿地道與配重撞擊的攻城技術經驗，連同軍需調度上的教訓，為貞觀十九年（645）李勣最終攻陷平壤預作了技術與行政上的準備，也讓唐軍第一次認真評估了冬雪與糧道對半島戰役的決定性影響。
impactEn: In the short term the episode at Hanjinluo changed nothing in the balance of power in Northeast Asia. The Tang took Anshi but never took Pyongyang; they were checked at the Han River and withdrew in the snow, and the second campaign against Goguryeo ended in failure. In the longer term, however, the cost bought three things. First, the Tang court learned that Goguryeo's system of fortified towns and the winter climate of the peninsula could offset the Tang advantages in equipment and numbers, and it turned thereafter to a mixture of long attrition and diplomacy: in the eighteenth year of Zhenguan it sent Xiao Yu, Tang Jian, Liu Jian and others to negotiate with Goguryeo, and by investiture and border trade bought a long stretch of quiet on the northeastern frontier. Second, officers such as Xue Rengui first showed what they were in this campaign, and their deeds became material endlessly rewritten by later historians and storytellers, providing the Tang dynasty with a full set of martial narratives. Third, the siege of Anshi accumulated practical experience in scaling ladders, siege towers, stone-throwing, mining under the walls and weighted battering, and in the administration of supply; together with the lessons of logistics, it prepared the technical and administrative ground on which Li Ji finally took Pyongyang in the nineteenth year of Zhenguan, and it taught the Tang army for the first time to weigh honestly how decisive winter snow and the grain route could be in a peninsular campaign.
result: 韓進洛一線的結果，按《舊唐書》《新唐書》《資治通鑑》互有出入的記載，可以這樣概括：唐軍在安市方向最終壓倒了高句麗的野外部隊，安市城被攻下，唐軍進軍至漢江，與平壤僅一水之隔；然而高句麗大軍在韓進洛一帶的抵抗切斷了唐軍的糧道，使唐軍自攻入遼東起便始終陷在糧秣不足的窘境，加之大雪封山、士卒僵仆，貞觀八年正月太宗詔令班師，唐軍退回遼東、渡海還師，於平壤一無所成。這場戰役的直接結果，是唐軍的一次戰術勝利與戰略失敗：安市等數城得而復失，高句麗國力未受重創，政權依然完整。次年太宗改遣蕭瑀等出使高句麗，衝突轉以外交收束。需要說明的是，關於韓進洛此戰的具體經過、交戰部署與斬獲數字，古籍僅存片言，學界至今未有一致意見；本篇所述以可確證的時間線與地望為骨架，細節則取最通行的解釋，並把存疑之處明白標出。
resultEn: As for the outcome at Hanjinluo, the Old Book of Tang, the New Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror disagree with one another, but the shape of the result can be set out this way. The Tang army finally overwhelmed Goguryeo's field forces in the Anshi sector, the city of Anshi was taken, and the army advanced to the Han River, a single stretch of water away from Pyongyang. Yet the resistance of the Goguryeo army around Hanjinluo cut the Tang supply line, and from the moment the army entered Liaodong it was trapped in a shortage of rations; added to a heavy fall of snow sealing the passes and men freezing in the open, it forced Taizong to order the withdrawal in the first month of Zhenguan eight. The army fell back through Liaodong and recrossed the sea, achieving nothing at Pyongyang. The immediate result was therefore a tactical victory and a strategic defeat for the Tang: towns such as Anshi were taken and then abandoned, the strength of Goguryeo was not materially broken, and the state remained intact. The following year Taizong changed course and sent Xiao Yu and others as envoys, and the conflict was wound up diplomatically. It must be said that the specific course of the fighting at Hanjinluo, the deployment of the troops and the casualty and capture figures survive only in fragments, and scholars still hold no agreed view; what follows here is built on the firmly attested chronology and geography, with the details taken from the most widely accepted reading and every doubtful point flagged as such.
